name: 2-Minute Healthy Snacks
equipment: A few pantry and fridge staples
instructions: Stock a few "zero-prep" options at all times: a piece of fruit, a string cheese, a handful of nuts, a hard-boiled egg.
Keep them at eye level in the fridge or pantry -- the easiest option wins when you are genuinely hungry and short on time.
Notice the difference between true hunger and boredom before reaching for a snack; both are normal, but they call for different responses.
Watch today's video for snacks that take under two minutes to put together.
